title: Understanding Fieldtypes
excerpt: Explore the various fieldtypes available in HaruCMS and how to use them effectively. From text fields to rich content editors, learn what each type offers.
content:
HaruCMS offers a variety of fieldtypes to suit your content needs. Each fieldtype provides different capabilities for managing your data.

Common Fieldtypes

  • Text: Simple single-line text input
  • Textarea: Multi-line text input
  • Rich Text: Full-featured WYSIWYG editor
  • Media: File and image uploads
  • Tags: Tag management
  • Relation: Link entries together

Choose the right fieldtype for each piece of content to create a structured, manageable content model.
